title: How Well Do You REALLY Know Pokémon? ⚡ 50 Pokémon Trivia Questions | Pokémon Quiz #17
title_b_variant: Think You REALLY Know {series}? 🤔 Prove It in {count} Questions | Quiz #{number}
description_hook: ⚡ From Pallet Town to Paldea: 50 Pokémon questions that'll sort the Pokémon Masters from the rookie trainers.
tags: how well do you know pokemon
tags_research: 23 Nov 2026: vidIQ out of credits (4 left), and the Google suggest endpoint is blocked from the cloud shell, so YouTube autocomplete via TubeAlfred for 'pokemon quiz' (quizzes, quiz show, hard, game; the 'wrong answers' variants left out, not our format) plus a TubeAlfred search: Pokémon quiz videos with 1M+ views (Jaiden 4.1M, MandJTV 2.5M, Nokimon 1.1-1.8M).

questions.note: Giulia, 6 and 10 Nov 2026: no approval stops; fully automated. Written and fact-checked by Claude 23 Nov 2026 (weekly run). Medium, what a real fan knows; hardest Q36-50. Q1-3 follow the first-3 rules (23 Nov): under 12 words, picture-led; Q1 near-certain (Pikachu), Q2 famous with a fun reveal (Poké Ball / Master Ball), Q3 a 'did you know?' twist (Bulbasaur is #1 but Rhydon was designed first). Most recognisable picture at Q10 (Snorlax). Movie questions Q20 (Mewtwo) and Q24 (Detective Pikachu). All GIFs anime/game characters, so no real faces expected; Q24 still to be checked for live-action actors.

questions.question: What is the name of Ash's famous yellow Pokémon?
questions.reveal: Pikachu refused to go in its Poké Ball in the very first episode.

questions.question: Which ball do trainers throw to catch Pokémon?
questions.reveal: The Master Ball catches any wild Pokémon without fail.

questions.question: Which Pokémon is number 1 in the Pokédex?
questions.reveal: But it wasn't the first designed: that was Rhydon.

questions.question: What type of Pokémon is Charmander?
questions.reveal: The flame on its tail shows how strong its life force is.

questions.question: What does Pikachu evolve into?
questions.reveal: It needs a Thunder Stone to evolve.

questions.question: Which pink Pokémon sings everyone to sleep?
questions.reveal: In the anime, it draws on the faces of anyone who falls asleep.

questions.question: What is the name of Team Rocket's talking cat Pokémon?
questions.reveal: In the anime, it taught itself to talk to impress another Meowth.

questions.question: Which Water-type starter is a small blue turtle?
questions.reveal: Ash's Squirtle once led a gang called the Squirtle Squad.

questions.question: What colour is a shiny Charizard?
questions.reveal: Its wings and tail flame stay red.

questions.question: Which sleepy giant Pokémon blocks the road in Pokémon Red and Blue?
questions.reveal: You need the Poké Flute to wake it up.

questions.question: How many Pokémon were there in the original games?
questions.reveal: Mew, number 151, was secretly added at the last minute by programmer Shigeru Morimoto.

questions.question: Which Pokémon evolves into Gyarados?
questions.reveal: Its first move is Splash, which does absolutely nothing.

questions.question: What is the name of Ash's hometown?
questions.reveal: Pallet Town is also where Professor Oak's lab is.

questions.question: Which professor gives Ash his first Pokémon?
questions.reveal: Ash was late and only Pikachu was left.

questions.question: What is the word 'Pokémon' short for?
questions.reveal: The games launched in Japan as Pocket Monsters in 1996.

questions.question: Name a type that's super effective against Water.
questions.reveal: Both do double damage to Water-type Pokémon.

questions.question: Which Pokémon does Eevee become with a Water Stone?
questions.reveal: Vaporeon can melt into water and become invisible, says the Pokédex.

questions.question: Which legendary Pokémon is on the cover of Pokémon Silver?
questions.reveal: Ho-Oh is on the cover of Pokémon Gold.

questions.question: What is the name of Ash's first rival in the anime?
questions.reveal: He's Professor Oak's grandson.

questions.question: Which psychic Pokémon is the villain of the first Pokémon film?
questions.reveal: It was created from the DNA of Mew.

questions.question: Which grinning purple Pokémon is a Ghost and Poison type?
questions.reveal: The Pokédex says the air goes cold when Gengar is nearby.

questions.question: Who runs the Pokémon Centers in the anime?
questions.reveal: Almost every town has a Nurse Joy, and they're all relatives who look the same.

questions.question: What is the name of Ash's talking Pokédex in the English dub?
questions.reveal: Dexter describes every new Pokémon Ash meets.

questions.question: In the 2019 film Detective Pikachu, what does Pikachu wear?
questions.reveal: It's the same style of hat Sherlock Holmes wears.

questions.question: What does Charmeleon evolve into?
questions.reveal: It looks like a dragon, but it's Fire and Flying, not Dragon type.

questions.question: How many Gym Badges do you need to enter the Pokémon League?
questions.reveal: Ash earned his first one, the Boulder Badge, from Brock.

questions.question: What does Psyduck constantly suffer from?
questions.reveal: When the pain gets bad, it unleashes psychic powers.

questions.question: The Galar region is based on which country?
questions.reveal: Its biggest city, Wyndon, is based on London.

questions.question: Which Pokémon wears a skull and carries a bone?
questions.reveal: It's known as the Lonely Pokémon.

questions.question: What does Bulbasaur evolve into?
questions.reveal: Ivysaur's bud blooms when it evolves into Venusaur.

questions.question: Which Electric move is Ash's Pikachu most famous for?
questions.reveal: It's Pikachu's signature attack all through the anime.

questions.question: In which year did the mobile game Pokémon GO come out?
questions.reveal: It was downloaded more than 500 million times within months.

questions.question: What is Eevee's Electric-type evolution called?
questions.reveal: Its fur stands up like needles when it's charged.

questions.question: Which Fire starter from Pokémon Gold and Silver has flames on its back?
questions.reveal: It's a shy fire mouse that flares up when it's frightened.

questions.question: Which two Team Rocket members travel with Meowth?
questions.reveal: Their motto begins: 'Prepare for trouble!'

questions.question: What is Pikachu's Pokédex number?
questions.reveal: Pichu, its baby form, is number 172.

questions.question: Which pink Pokémon can transform into any other Pokémon?
questions.reveal: It copies the Pokémon it sees, moves and all.

questions.question: Name the three legendary birds of Kanto.
questions.reveal: Ice, Electric and Fire, each part Flying type.

questions.question: What is Eevee's Ice-type evolution called?
questions.reveal: It arrived with Pokémon Diamond and Pearl.

questions.question: What item does a Pokémon hold to Mega Evolve?
questions.reveal: Its trainer also needs a Key Stone.

questions.question: What is the region in Pokémon Scarlet and Violet called?
questions.reveal: It's inspired by Spain and Portugal.

questions.question: Which legendary Pokémon did Ash see in the very first episode?
questions.reveal: It flew over a rainbow as Ash and Pikachu watched.

questions.question: Which professor gives you your starter in Pokémon Sun and Moon?
questions.reveal: The games are set in Alola, based on Hawaii.

questions.question: Which type was added in Pokémon X and Y?
questions.reveal: It was added to balance out powerful Dragon types.

questions.question: What two types is Gyarados?
questions.reveal: Even though it has no wings!

questions.question: Which Pokémon has the most different evolutions?
questions.reveal: It has eight, nicknamed the Eeveelutions.

questions.question: Which professor hands out starters in Pokémon X and Y?
questions.reveal: Sycamore is a tree, just like Oak, Elm and Rowan.

questions.question: Which Electric-type squirrel comes from Diamond and Pearl?
questions.reveal: Dawn's Pachirisu loves to show off in Contests.

questions.question: Which Mythical Pokémon from Gen 2 can travel through time?
questions.reveal: It's known as the guardian of the forest.

questions.question: Which Pokémon was the first one ever designed?
questions.reveal: It's number 112 in the Pokédex, but Game Freak drew it before any other.
